title: The stowaway
summary: On a trip abroad, the hotel porter opens the luggage hold of the team bus and a girl of fifteen climbs out with a rucksack and your shirt on. She came all the way in there. The gaffer wants her on the first flight home. A season on she's banned from the ground, and years on she's working in it.

ends.title: The apprentice
ends.text: The girl from the luggage hold works in the club's kit room now. She packs the bus herself and checks the hold twice.

ends.title: The banned season
ends.text: She served her ban and came back with a season ticket she paid for herself, in the away end, every away game.

ends.title: On the first flight
ends.text: She was on the first flight home with a steward, and you never heard from her again. The hold of the bus has a lock on it now.

beats.title: The luggage hold

event.title: The luggage hold
event.speaker: kidfan
setup: The hotel abroad, ten at night. The porter opens the bus's luggage hold for the kit hampers and a girl climbs out with a rucksack, stiff as a board, in your shirt.
She's fifteen. She got in at the services before the ferry. Nine hours.

say: The gaffer is in the car park in his slippers, already on the phone to the club. "Police, her mother, a flight. In that order."

replies.label: Sit with her while he rings.
"Let me ring her mum. She'll take it better from me."
Go up to your room. It's his problem.

say: She won't look at you. "I just wanted to see one away. Mum said we couldn't afford it." She's shaking. Somebody brings her a hotel dressing gown.

replies.label: "I'll get you a ticket for tomorrow. If he lets me."
"You need to go home. I'll ring you after."

say: Her mum picks up on the first ring, and she's been crying for hours. "Is she all right? Is she hurt? I'll kill her."

replies.label: "She's fine. Let her see the game, and I'll bring her home."
"She's fine. She'll be on the first flight."

ticket.text: The gaffer stares at you for a long time. Then: "Steward with her. Hotel room with a woman from the club. And she's YOUR problem." She watches from the away end with a steward either side.

home.text: She's on the seven o'clock flight with a woman from the club. She writes on your hand in biro before she goes: SORRY.

away.text: You hear the police car come and go. At breakfast nobody says her name.

beats.hint: Somebody has climbed out of the team bus's luggage hold

beats.title: The papers

event.title: The papers
event.speaker: kidfan
setup: It's in every paper: SUPERFAN, 15, IN TEAM BUS HOLD. The club is talking about a ban. Her mum has sent you a message through the club's office.

say: Your own mum has read it twice. "That poor woman. Nine hours, love. Anything could have happened."

replies.label: Ask the club to go easy on her.
Tell the club a ban is right.

speak.text: The club gives her a season's ban instead of five. The chairman says it's because of you, and doesn't say it nicely.

ban.text: Five seasons, the club says, and then they halve it. She posts a photo of her bedroom wall with your face on it, and then takes it down.

out.text: The club bans her for three seasons. You read it on your phone in the canteen.

beats.hint: The stowaway is in the papers

beats.title: A letter

event.title: A letter
event.speaker: kidfan
setup: A season on. A letter at reception, four sides, very neat. She's doing her exams. She's been watching every game on the radio. She's got a Saturday job to pay back the club for the flight.
{if arc.path=='ticket'}She's put the ticket stub from the away end in with it.{/if}

say: "I know I can't come for ages. I just wanted to say I'm sorry for the trouble and I'm saving up for when I can."

replies.label: Take a signed ball round to her school.
Put it in the drawer with the others.

visit.text: The whole year group comes out to the playground. She goes the colour of the shirt and then tells you she wants to work in football, not watch it.

write.text: She writes back by return. She wants to work in football, she says, behind the scenes, where you don't need to be good.

file.text: The letter goes in the drawer.

beats.hint: A season on, the stowaway has written to you

event.title: Years on
event.speaker: kidfan
setup: Years on. There's a new apprentice in the kit room, nineteen, with her hair in a scrunchie and a list on a clipboard.
{if arc.mid=='ban'}She doesn't smile when she sees you, but she nods.{/if}

say: "Don't," she says, before you can say anything. "I check the hold twice now. Every trip."

laugh.text: She laughs, and the kit man shouts at her to stop laughing and fold.
She doesn't laugh. Later you see her in the away end on her day off, with a ticket she paid for.

proud.text: She looks at her clipboard for a while. "Go and get changed, you're late."
"You didn't even come down to the car park," she says, and goes back to folding.

nod.text: She nods back. Next away trip, there's a padlock on the hold.
She nods back. Next away game you see her in the away end on her day off.
